items.source: A strategy to apply CORS validation checks and updates to a ServerWebExchange, either rejecting through the response or adding CORS related headers, based on a pre-selected CorsConfiguration.
items.translation: 一种策略，用于根据预选择的CorsConfiguration对ServerWebExchange应用 CORS 验证检查和更新，要么通过响应拒绝请求，要么添加与 CORS 相关的标头。

items.source: Process a request using the given CorsConfiguration.
configuration - the CORS configuration to use; possibly null in which case pre-flight requests are rejected, but all others allowed.
items.translation: configuration - 要使用的 CORS 配置；可能为 null，在这种情况下会拒绝预检请求，但允许所有其他请求。

items.source: false if the request was rejected, true otherwise
items.translation: false 表示请求被拒绝，否则为 true。
